576109.name: The Friendship Circle of Pittsburgh
576109.note: Its own site: 'The Friendship Circle of Pittsburgh was established in 2006'; 'In 2006, Rabbi Mordy and Rivkee Rudolph brought this vision to our community, founding The Friendship Circle of Pittsburgh'. (The Pittsburgh Jewish Chronicle dates the start to September 2006.)

4736226.name: Chabad of Erie County
4736226.note: Lubavitch.com (3 Aug 2020, 'New Shluchim to Erie, PA'): 'Just as soon as coronavirus restrictions ease up, Chabad will open in Erie, Pennsylvania. Rabbi Dovie and Mushkie Kivman will move from their home in Brooklyn'; Lubavitch.com (13 Oct 2020): Rabbi Yisroel Rosenfeld 'recently appointed three other couples, including the Kivmans who established Chabad of Erie'. Its listing went up June 10 2020.

117721.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Western PA
117721.note: Lubavitch.com (13 Oct 2020): 'Rabbi Sholom and Chaya Posner established Chabad of Western Pennsylvania'; the Pittsburgh Jewish Chronicle (9 Jan 2020): 'Rabbi Sholom Posner arrived in Pittsburgh in the summer of 1943' (Rabbi Mordechai Dov Altein had come in Dec 1941 and started the yeshiva in 1942, a separate listing). Medium: the year is the Posners' arrival; when the name Chabad Lubavitch of Western PA came into use is not found. Rabbi Yisroel Rosenfeld directs it (2100 Wightman St.).

6134464.name: Our Giving Kitchen Pittsburgh
6134464.note: Donorbox's case study: 'Founded in 2020 by Rabbi Chezky and Bassie Rosenfeld'. Medium: the Pittsburgh Jewish Chronicle (May 2025) says he founded it 'four years ago' (about 2021), on upper Murray Avenue. Its listing went up Oct 18 2023.

3532791.name: Chabad at Pitt
3532791.note: Its own story: 'In September of 2015, Chasi and Shmuli Rothstein arrived in Pittsburgh with the goal of strengthening the Jewish Community at the University of Pittsburgh'; they later moved to a large house on campus (full by 2019). Its listing went up Dec 21 2016. (The older Chabad House on Campus, the Weinsteins' since 1988, is a separate listing.)
